title: PARTROOT196: integer-root schedule, explicit root-leading bound and exact joint57735027/50000000 envelope

claims.statement: For the single physical PARTROOT196 uniform algorithm completely supplied in proof.md and virtual.md, for everyN>=2 ands moduloN,n=ceil(log2N),entire-secret recovery succeeds unconditionally with probability>=1-2^-7 from independent idealcopies. Mainn>=2^512 uses growing odd-partitionk=leastodd>=ceil(n^(1/8)),fully charged growingcompiler16F,z0=min{j:3j²>=n},z=z0+16ceilLogn,ell=m=dl=z,rolling exact backwardC_i before bank allocation,Y=ceilLogC0,u=max(Y,2z)+2 and fullycounted basisbank/unknownwire/CQ physical completion. Every branch jointly has T=O(2^((57735027/50000000)*sqrt n)),ordinaryS_C=O(n),fullallocatedS_Q=O(2^((57735027/50000000)*sqrt n)),Q=O(2^((57735027/50000000)*sqrt n));all sourcecalls,failure,retry,partialattempt,abort,fulladdress,initialization,inactiveprefix,parameterwork,compiler,lifecycle,finiteepochrepair andcleanup count. Explicit stronger common bound isC*2^[(2/sqrt3)sqrt n+512n^(7/16)],with absoluteC;the exactselected rationalcoefficient is57735027/50000000. This time bound has exactindex1/2.
